visual.description: Warm off-white parchment texture used as the primary page background throughout the site.
Very dark navy-black used for large display headings and section titles.
Dark charcoal used for body copy and paragraph text.
Medium grey used for secondary labels, captions, and de-emphasized text.
Medium purple used for highlight backgrounds behind key words in headlines and as the primary brand accent.
Bright violet-purple used for the 'Febby' user tag badge and interactive highlights.
Purple used for hyperlinks and inline text links throughout the page.
Pure white used for card surfaces, modal backgrounds, and the calendar app UI.
Very dark near-black surface used in the dark calendar app UI and dark dropdown menus.
Dark purple-grey used as the background for the app interface panels and dark UI sections.
Vivid violet that anchors the purple-to-lavender gradient used in meeting event card headers.
Mid-range purple appearing in gradient transitions within event card backgrounds.
Warm coral-orange used in feature section card backgrounds ('Automated Templates', 'Smart Tasks').
Medium blue used in calendar event chips, feature cards, and section gradient backgrounds.
Deeper navy-blue used in the dark calendar view event blocks and UI chrome.
Soft peach/salmon gradient tone appearing in warm-toned feature card backgrounds.
Light lavender used as the text highlight background behind 'need to meet' in the hero headline.
Green used for the checkmark/going indicator on meeting RSVP state.
Red used for the macOS-style close button dot in app window chrome.
Amber/yellow used for the macOS-style minimize button dot in app window chrome.
Lighter green used for the macOS-style maximize button dot in app window chrome.
Indigo-purple used for the 'Google Calendar Sync' and 'Notifications' pill links in the nav area.
Very light lavender-grey used for subtle dividers and borders in the calendar sidebar.
Soft purple pill background for nav feature links when scrolled.
